children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest a support at $6.63-1/4 per bushel, a break below which could trigger a fall into the $6.57 to $6.59-3/4 range.

The support caused two bounces. The second one looks much weaker, which has ended around a resistance at $6.74. The weak bounce, along with the subsequent fall, suggests a continuation of the downtrend from $6.91-1/2.
A break above $6.71-3/4 may lead to a gain into the $6.74 to $6.77-1/4 range. On the daily chart, the market remains flat around a support at $6.68-1/2.
The sideways move is considered a very weak bounce, which suggests a steady downtrend from $7.94-1/2. The contract is expected to drop toward $6.38-1/2.
